meaning.zh: 在指定受限现金、独立现金承诺及额外经营储备条件下的资金余量；并非银行负余额或可提取资金。
meaning.en: Cash remaining against the specified restrictions, distinct commitments and additional operating reserve; not a negative bank balance or withdrawable cash.

deductionRules.definition: Unavailable cash; no same amount may also be counted as committed cash.
Separate commitments not already funded/countable under restricted cash; excludes extra operating reserve.
Additional reserve target beyond restricted/committed amounts; not a second count of either.
Not deducted by native metric. Nonzero/overlapping/unclassified obligations require separate review; do not relabel result as cash after all obligations.

overlapDeclaration.claim: Non-overlap is an explicit demonstration assumption, not inferred from unknown real sources.
